title: Solver rule for approximate questions: nearest option, compute ambiguous readings (REQ-0080)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 dev prompt rule + synthetic test, golden
AC2 regset re-score and DGNL Math 63

design.summary: dev prompt rule for approximate questions: compute plausible readings and choose the nearest option; tests, then a Math 63 re-solve and one regression-set dev run

implementation.summary: dev prompt rule 6 (English) and rule 5 (Vietnamese) for approximate questions: compute plausible readings, choose the nearest option, list readings and distances in checks; release prompts untouched

unit_test.result: 1404 tests, only the known baseline failures (coder run); release prompts byte-identical on 47 examples/evals inputs; the rule is in both dev prompts, absent from release; regression set run on the dev channel with the rule shows no regression (run5: 15 pass, 0 fail, 3 uncertain)

verification.command: unit suite (coder); Math 63 re-solve twice and the regression set once on the dev channel
verification.result: REQ-0080 verified with a stated partial outcome: the rule is in the dev solve prompts and applied (solver listed readings and distances) but Math 63 did not flip (0 of 2; a reading ambiguity, REQ-0082); regression set with the rule: 15 pass, 0 fail, 3 uncertain, no regression; release prompts byte-identical; limits: 3 items per kind, one question tested for the target behaviour

quality.reason: per-item verdict comparison of two dev regression runs, official answers for Math 63

tester.waiver: covered by coder tests and the real regression run

verifier.waiver: evidence is a real regression run with matching per-item verdicts plus coder tests; the outcome (Math 63 not fixed) is stated plainly

crosscheck.waiver: the oracle is the official answers (Math 63 re-solved twice, not fixed, stated) and a real regression run with per-item verdict comparison
